description: A WinUI 3 desktop app created with Windows App SDK 1.0 cannot find a reliable Acrylic window backdrop API, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/70231916/how-to-implement-acrylic-windows-effect-in-winui3-in-desktop-application.
prompt: I made a WinUI 3 desktop app with Windows App SDK 1.0 in VS 2022 and want the main window to have Acrylic like the Windows 11 apps. Samples I found look like UWP or WinUI 2, and they don't compile here. What's the supported way?
